name: FortiWeb — Web Application DoS/DDoS Protection Triggered
description: Detects FortiWeb DoS/DDoS protection triggering (HTTP or TCP flood prevention) against a public banking application — indicating a volumetric or application-layer denial-of-service attempt on the bank's web services.
note:
## Investigation
1. `data.original_src`/`x_forwarded_for` and `data.http_host` show the source and target; assess the request rate.
2. Distinguish a genuine DDoS from a traffic spike or a misbehaving client.
## Response
If a real flood, engage upstream DDoS mitigation and rate-limit the source(s).
author: raadabujaish
query: tags:"Fortiweb" and data.type:"attack" and (data.main_type:"DoS Protection" or data.attack_type:("TCP Flood Prevention" or "HTTP Flood Prevention"))
